title: Quick Roasted Dutch Chestnut Mushroom Stew
description: A rich and cozy Dutch dish featuring chestnut mushrooms, kombu cold extract, and egg free friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced mushrooms with olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the mushrooms out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the kombu cold extract, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the roasted mushrooms and vegetable broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
